full_details.title: Windows Income & Expense Manager
full_details.full_description:
I need a straightforward desktop application for Windows that lets me record, review, and share income and expense data with my small team. The program must feel native to Windows, install with a simple setup file, and keep everything local (no browser dependencies).

Core requirements I want to see built in:  

• Data import/export – at minimum CSV; Excel or PDF support is a plus.  
• Report generation – clear summaries filtered by date range, category, and user.  
• Multi-user support – individual log-ins with their own permission levels and an admin account to manage them.

I’m flexible on the tech stack as long as it runs smoothly on current Windows versions; C#/WPF, Electron, JavaFX—whatever you’re most productive with works for me. Please include the compiled executable, full source code, and a brief read-me so I can rebuild or extend the app later. If you’ve built similar finance tools before, links or screenshots will help me decide quickly.
